India is often told that its global stature has never been higher. Viral clips of sharp interviews, “laser-eye” edits of diplomats, and grand speeches create the image of a rising superpower. But does the reality of India’s foreign policy match the narrative?

In this video, we examine whether India’s diplomacy under Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar is delivering real strategic gains or mostly optics. From Russian oil diplomacy and sanctions pressure to China’s growing influence around India’s neighborhood, the contradictions are becoming harder to ignore. At the same time, anti-India sentiment and racism against Indians abroad appear to be rising, raising questions about how effectively Indian interests are being protected globally.

We also look at geopolitical shifts in alliances, the challenges posed by China’s expanding presence in South Asia, and why narrative wars on global platforms matter more than ever.

Is India truly becoming a global power, or are we mistaking viral diplomacy for real influence?

Watch till the end and decide for yourself.
